5,8._doc: BMC I 680: Alde 3030 panel warning/attention flag (PanelBusy). RENAMED alde_error → alde_warning in v2.65.6 per @FrankHae (issue #9): this slot fires for panel-attention/lockouts (e.g. the antibacterial/Legionella boiler-service reminder) rather than a hard fault, so it is semantically a WARNING. REMAPPED from slot 12 → slot 8 in v2.65.1 on @FrankHae's on-vehicle evidence: during a real Alde panel reminder (13–14 Jul 2026) slot 8 read True for the whole window and False otherwise, while slot 12 stayed False throughout. True = an action/warning is pending at the Alde panel that can block remote on/off from HA and the EHG app until acknowledged on the panel with OK. NOTE: only the boolean is transmitted via the SCU — the actual message TEXT is panel-only and never sent over PIA. The real hard-fault flag is slot 12 (alde_error). Bus 5 unused on S600/S700/ML-T.
5,8.name: alde_warning

lights._doc: Keyed by bus_id. Convention: sid 1=on/off (bool), sid 2=brightness (uint 0-100%), sid 3=color_temp (uint 0-100%). Set brightness/color_temp to true if the light supports it.

switches._doc: Keyed by bus_id,sensor_id. write_type: str|bool|uint. on_value: readback value that means ON. holdoff_off: seconds to hold optimistic OFF state (for SCU bounce-back).

10,1._doc: BMC I 680: TenHaaft satellite dish On/Off switch. Command-pair (momentary): ON = Start (deploy + auto-search, bus 10 slot 1, bool true); OFF = Park (retract to safe position, bus 10 slot 2, bool true). State fed from SafePositionState (10,10) INVERTED via on_value=false: parked (safe position=true) shows OFF, deployed shows ON. WRITES CONFIRMED on bus 10 slots 1/2 by @FrankHae on-vehicle (issue #13, 2026-07-20): the switch actually deploys/retracts the dish. holdoff_off 90s covers the retract/deploy travel time.
10,1.name: sat_control

climate._doc: Bus/slot IDs for heater, fridge, and boiler controls. Python write logic stays in climate.py and select.py — only bus IDs are parameterized here.

numbers._doc: Generic JSON-driven writable float slots (v2.65.5+). Written to the SCU as a 32-bit float via the multi-sensor command path (same as the Truma climate setpoint).

alde_setpoint._doc: BMC I 680 (MY2024): Alde 3030 Zone-1 target temperature (bus 5 slot 3 = Zone1TargetTemperature, rw float °C). Confirmed writable in the decompiled EHG app (componentId 5, id 3, mode 'rw', datatype 'float'). Read sensor alde_setpoint (5,3). WRITE PATH UNVERIFIED on bus 5 slot 3 — test control (v2.65.5); revert if the SCU drops the float write.
alde_setpoint.name: Alde setpoint

alde_zone2_setpoint._doc: Alde 3030 Zone-2 target temperature (bus 5 slot 4 = zone_2_target_temperature, rw float °C per decompiled EHG app Alde3020). Slider mirroring the Zone-1 setpoint, added per @FrankHae request (issue #9, v2.65.7) for future dual-zone floorplans (780/880). WRITE PATH UNVERIFIED — no dual-zone vehicle available to test; BMC I 680 is single-zone. Read sensor alde_zone2_setpoint (5,4).
alde_zone2_setpoint.name: Alde Zone 2 setpoint

fridge_absorber_cooling_step._doc: BMC I 680 (MY2024): Thetford N4142E+ absorber fridge Off/1-5 cooling-step control (bus 32). Mirrors the S600 N4000 (bus 34) and ML-T compressor (bus 114) drivers: power sid 1 (bool) then cooling-step sid 3 (uint). Readback confirmed by @FrankHae 2026-07-11 (issue #9); WRITE PATH still to be verified on-vehicle. Revert if the SCU does not accept the cloud write.
fridge_absorber_cooling_step.name: Absorber fridge cooling step

alde_energy_priority._doc: BMC I 680 (MY2024): Alde 3030 energy-priority select (bus 5 slot 5, string rw). WRITE PATH UNVERIFIED on bus 5 — test control (v2.64.8). If the SCU rejects the literal option string, the app's enum keys 'PRIO_GAS'/'PRIO_EL' are the fallback. Revert if writes are dropped.
alde_energy_priority.name: Alde energy priority

alde_electric_boost._doc: BMC I 680 (MY2024): Alde 3030 electric booster heater level (bus 5 slot 7 = ElectricitySetting, int 0-3 kW, rw per decompiled EHG app Alde3020). alde_electric_boost.name: Alde electric booster
